archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with ELECTRIC & NEON (Awwwards Style)

header.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0D0B]/70 border-b border-white/10

hero.animation: framer-motion line-by-line masked reveal (overflow-hidden on text lines, y-axis translation)

cards_services.classes: bg-[#121714] border border-[#242E28] p-8 rounded-2xl hover:-translate-y-2 transition-transform duration-300 group

buttons.primary: bg-[#BAFF29] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#A3E622] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: border border-white/20 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors

motion_and_interactions.marquee: react-fast-marquee (slow, editorial style, border-y border-white/10, huge serif/display text)
motion_and_interactions.image_hover: Scale image 1.05x inside overflow-hidden clipped frame

media.image_treatment: Deliberate framing, subtle brightness/contrast tweaks, grayscale on hover or full color on hover. Corner radiuses max 16px or completely sharp.

hero_background.description: Modern building with tall cypress trees - perfect for luxury moody hero

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has gradient overlays or drop shadows.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Lenis smooth scrolling at the root of the app.
2. Use Framer Motion to create a kinetic text hero: Split 'PRECISION. NATURE. MASTERY.' into separate lines. Wrap each in an overflow-hidden div and animate the text up from y: 100%.
3. Build a dark theme page. The background must be #0A0D0B, NOT pure black.
4. For the 'Services' section, use a Bento Grid layout (1 col mobile, 3 cols desktop) with cards that feature subtle borders (#242E28) and dark surfaces.
5. Include a Numbered Manifesto section ('01. Licensed & Bonded', etc) using large typography and border-b dividers.
6. Add an infinite Marquee using react-fast-marquee with text like 'SERVING SAN JOSE CA SINCE 2003 • FREE ESTIMATES • '. Make it massive and low contrast.
7. Include a fully functional contact form (Free Estimate) at the bottom before the footer.
8. Ensure the header has a backdrop-blur and is fixed at the top.
9. Use Outfit for headings and DM Sans for body. Add font links in index.html or import in CSS.
10. Apply `data-testid` to ALL links, buttons, and form inputs.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align text globally.
Use generous spacing (py-24 to py-32 for sections).
Never use transparent headers without a blur/scrim effect.
Ensure hover states exist for all interactive elements.
